fidelity_definition.F0_CLT: Deterministic Classical Lamination Theory using an experimentally anchored RTD material card. Not a finite-element or experimental label.

material_source.title: Hexcel 8552 IM7 Unidirectional Prepreg Material Property Data Report
material_source.distribution: Approved for public release; distribution unlimited.

design_rules.disorientation: Recorded but not restricted below 90 degrees in v1; users may filter.

known_limitations: F0 labels omit geometric stress concentrations, contact, damage evolution, and impact dynamics.
The NCAMP table provides condition-level means; raw coupon traces are not copied into this release.
Density is a representative report value rather than a batch-specific measurement for each row.
A future numerical-experimental v2 must add paired laminate/subcomponent tests; planned rows are not observations.
